data.long_meaning: Delaney is an Anglicized form of the Irish name Deirdre, meaning 'sorrowful'. The Old English name Delan meaning 'wise, bright' is also a potential origin. This name conveys a sense of brightness and freedom. The name Delaney carries the meaning “Free, bright one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Delaney usually hope their child will grow to embody free, bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ντελένη
in_greek.meaning: Το Ντελένη σημαίνει αγριόσκυλος ή λύκος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντελένη προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει αγριόσκυλος ή λύκος. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Ντελένη έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια του δυνατού και του γενναίου, όπως ο λύκος ή ο αγριόσκυλος.

in_latin.name: Delaney

In Christian tradition, the name Delaney symbolizes strength, courage, and determination.

historical_references.reference: One popular etymology for the surname Delaney is that it is an anglicized form of the Irish name Ó Dochartaigh, which means 'descendant of Dochartach'. Dochartach was a high king of Ireland in the 11th century, who was known for his military prowess and leadership.

Another theory suggests that the name Delaney may have originated as a variant of the Irish name Delauney, which was derived from the French name de la Neuve, meaning 'of the new'. This name was given to Irish families who had recently adopted Christianity and settled in France during the Middle Ages.
